name: Octagon Stock Quote Skill to Google Sheets - Template Ready GPT 5.4 Mini

parameters.content:
## Octagon Stock Quote Skill → Google Sheets

### What this workflow does

This workflow turns a Google Sheet of stock tickers into a live quote enrichment pipeline using Octagon Agent and the `stock-quote` skill.

1. Start the workflow manually.
2. Fetch the latest public `stock-quote` skill instructions from GitHub.
3. Read stock tickers from your Google Sheet.
4. Build a precise Octagon Agent prompt for each ticker using OpenAI `gpt-5.4-mini`.
5. Retrieve real-time quote data through Octagon Agent.
6. Parse the response into stock-specific quote fields.
7. Update the same Google Sheet row by matching on `Ticker`.

### Google Sheets setup

Use a Google Sheet with one row per stock ticker. The sheet must include these exact column headers:

`Ticker`, `Current Price`, `Change`, `Volume`, `Day Range`, `52-Week Range`, `Market Cap`, `Exchange`, `Previous Close`, `Date`, `Octagon Response`

Recommended setup:

- [ ] Duplicate your stock quote Google Sheet template or create a new sheet with the exact columns above: 

https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1onmnZmFFBy3eqSpbIDgrswv1LQ34D1EievWM-B0R4y0/edit?usp=sharing

- [ ] Add ticker symbols in the `Ticker` column, for example `AAPL`, `MSFT`, `NVDA`, `TSLA`.
- [ ] Leave the quote/output columns blank; the workflow will populate them.
- [ ] In both Google Sheets nodes, select your duplicated spreadsheet and the worksheet tab that contains these columns.
- [ ] Keep `Ticker` as the matching column in the update node so each quote writes back to the correct row.

### Credentials required

- [ ] Configure Google Sheets OAuth credentials in both Sheets nodes.
- [ ] Configure OpenAI credentials in the prompt-builder node.
- [ ] Configure Octagon credentials in the Octagon Agent node.

### Customization

You can add more tickers by inserting new rows in the sheet. Keep the column names unchanged unless you also update the parser and Google Sheets mapping.

## Manual workflow start

Run this workflow manually after your Google Sheet has been prepared with stock tickers in the `Ticker` column.

## Skill and task setup

Defines the stock quote task and fetches the latest public `stock-quote` skill from GitHub. This keeps the workflow aligned with the current Octagon skill instructions.

## Read stock ticker rows

Reads your Google Sheet and keeps only rows where `Ticker` is not empty. Required input column: `Ticker`.

## Build and execute quote prompts

Loops over each valid ticker, uses OpenAI `gpt-5.4-mini` to build a precise Octagon Agent prompt, then sends it to Octagon Agent for live stock quote retrieval.

## Parse, update, and throttle

Parses Octagon output into the stock-specific columns, updates the matching Google Sheet row by `Ticker`, then waits briefly before processing the next row.
